content: Table TABREF44 shows average results of our automatic and human evaluations. Table TABREF45 shows average Hits@1/20 scores by evaluation character. See Appendix F for detailed evaluation results. ALOHA is the model with HLA-OG during training and testing, and ALOHA (No HLA-OG) is the model with HLA-OG during training but tested with the four HLAs in the OBS marked as `none' (see Section SECREF17). See Appendix G for demo interactions between a human, BERT bi-ranker baseline, and ALOHA for all five evaluation characters.
